thread:
sam: quick FYI — I landed a small probe to split token latency by kernel source (softbatch, decode, kv-prefetch, kernel-run). will run for 24h on canary routes

maria: sweet. what metric name did you add?

sam: added `infra.token_latency_by_source_seconds` as a histogram + label `kernel_source` and `route`. also a per-token counter for attribution: `infra.token_latency_attrib_seconds_sum` / `_count`

jules: can you paste the promql you're planning for the dashboard?

sam: sure — basic rollup: 
```
# percentiles per kernel source
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route, kernel_source) (rate(infra.token_latency_by_source_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
and a normalized kernel fraction: 
```
sum by(route, kernel_source) (rate(infra.token_latency_attrib_seconds_sum[5m])) /
sum by(route) (rate(infra.token_latency_attrib_seconds_sum[5m]))
```

kevin: nice. we should be careful with kv-prefetch double-counting — previous probes counted both prefetch and decode for the same token when cache missed

sam: yep — implemented an attribution mutex: prefetch only records when it actually pulled k/v (kv_hit=false). decode records the remaining time. hoping that reduces overlap noise

maria: what's the sampling config? we don't want to blow up metrics volume for prod

sam: probe uses 1/20 sampling per request, and within-request we sample 1/10 of tokens (prefer earlier tokens higher prob). config: `metrics.token_sampler: {request_p: 0.05, token_p: 0.1, bias: "front"}`

jules: can we add a heatmap panel showing per-route median vs 95th for kernel-run only? helps triage slow tails

sam: yes. proposed panels: small multiples by route — median (kernel_run), p95 (kernel_run), kv-prefetch hit-rate, avg batch-size. also a waterfall microview for single-request traces

kevin: FYI i saw a regression on /chat/compose yesterday; p95 increased ~18% after the scheduler change. might be related to softbatch handshake overhead

maria: can you point me to a trace?

kevin: uploaded a sample to the trace store: trace id `trace:2026-03-16-8849`. snapshot shows lots of small kernels started/stopped — kernel-init amortization noise

sam: can we repro in canary with sampling on that route? i'll enable a targeted probe for /chat/compose for 2h

ops-bot: deploy triggered by sam — feature: kernel-attrib-probe enabled on canary routes (uid=deploy-20260316-12) :rocket:

maria: if we enable for that route, let's monitor token attribution fractions closely. look for >10% variance vs baseline

jules: add an alert if any kernel_source fraction changes by >7% over 10m window vs 1h baseline

sam: added alert rule draft: `alert:KernelSourceRegression` — expr compares rolling 10m vs 1h baseline and triggers on >7% absolute diff. will post PR

kevin: one more idea — for KV noise, create a derived metric: `infra.kv_prefetch_effective_seconds = infra.token_latency_attrib_seconds_sum{kernel_source=\"kv-prefetch\"} - infra.kv_fetch_time_seconds` so we can see leftover time attributable to decode after prefetch

sam: good call. i'll add that to the dashboard with stacked bars so we can visually separate raw prefetch time vs residuals

maria: thanks team. if the canary looks clean after 2h, roll to dedicated and then we'll schedule a 24h sweep

kevin: sounds good. ping me if the alert fires — i'll take first pass investigation

sam: will do. logging the probe plan in the perf board: https://redwood.internal/perf/boards/latency-sources

ops-bot: deploy complete (deploy-20260316-12) — canary subset: 6 hosts.

jules: tiny nit — add `route_version` label so we can split rollout traffic from baseline

sam: good point. will include `route_version` and `deployment_tier` labels in the next patch

maria: awesome. thanks for doing this — should make kernel attribution a lot less fuzzy :thumbsup:

kevin: +1

sam: closing for now, will post results in ~3h or earlier if alert triggers
